comment: This section ("the most consequential implementation decision … is … what data to capture and how to structure it") is a strong, correct anchor and aligns the whole implementation chapter with a data-models-first approach. Recommend surfacing it earlier (it is the practical core of the guidance) and cross-referencing it from §3.4.5 and §3.6.1 so the architecture and implementation halves reinforce the same principle.
